standard_prerequisites: Cohomology and base change for a proper flat finitely presented morphism f : X to Y with F of finite presentation flat over Y: the object K = Rf_* F is perfect and its formation commutes with arbitrary base change (flat proper perfect direct image lemma)

The perfect complex openness lemma of the same chapter: for a perfect object K of D(O_Y) and fixed i, r there is an open V of Y such that T to Y factors through V if and only if K restricted over T is isomorphic to a finite locally free module of rank r placed in degree i (open where cohomology in degree i rank r lemma)
core_obligations: Perfectness with base change compatibility: by the cohomology and base change lemma the object K = Rf_* F is perfect in D(O_Y) and for every T to Y the derived pullback of K identifies with Rf_{T,*} F_T

Transfer of the criterion: for a morphism T to Y, the condition that Rf_{T,*} F_T is isomorphic to a finite locally free module of rank r placed in degree i is exactly the condition that K|_T is such a module; applying the perfect complex openness lemma to K yields the open subspace V with the required factorization property
proof_roadmap: Produce K = Rf_* F perfect with compatible base change from the flat proper direct image lemma
Rewrite the tested condition over T as the corresponding condition on the perfect object K over T and invoke the perfect openness lemma to get V
difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is the existence of an open subspace classifying exactly the base changes over which the direct image is a finite locally free module of rank r in degree i (source lines 6764-6785, label lemma-open-where-cohomology-in-degree-i-rank-r-geometric). The proof is a short but complete reduction: the whole content is to supply the perfectness and base change compatibility of K and then transfer the perfect openness criterion along the base change identification; both inputs are same-chapter citations and every step is argued in-span.
